name: multimodal_rca
description: General multi-modal triage workflow across metrics, logs, and traces for unknown or complex incidents.

steps.goal: Inspect schemas and available telemetry files to verify columns and coverage.
Analyze metrics in incident window across all components against 60-minute baseline.
Corroborate abnormal components with trace spans and error logs.
Separate initiating anomalies from propagated symptoms and check candidate onsets.
Return exact requested root cause elements conforming to task contract.

rules: Compute metric baseline before time filtering to prevent contamination.
Preserve component IDs exactly as declared in system schema.
Missing or truncated data lowers diagnostic confidence.
